items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: So we get there and here's Bix and we played and everything, we had a few drinks and were playing.

ctx.x: That's the bad part of it. There was no food. They had plenty of drinks, they had plenty of drinks, all the drinks you want and we're starving to death. I mean us guys in the Pollack band because we didn't have any money. We were inbetween jobs you know. You spend all your money when you're working.

So we get there and here's Bix and we played and everything, we had a few drinks and were playing. And I called Bix, I said I wanted to talk to him. I said I want to talk to you Bix, you know. So I told him,

look Bix, we're out of work and man I haven't got any money to buy food, you know, we haven't got a job. He said, well how much do you need? I said, all I need is five bucks, ten bucks and I'll pay you next....... He says, come on, really, so he pulled out four fifty dollar bills and gave me two hundred dollars.
